statements.speaker: Neha Kapoor
statements.text: Draft is 80% done. I’ll send it to Arjun for review by Wednesday.

statements.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
statements.text: I told Raghav I’d send him the updated vendor list. I’ll get that to him by end of day tomorrow.

statements.speaker: Raghav Sethi
statements.text: The Mumbai office renewal paperwork needs someone to sign off this week. Not sure whose desk that’s on right now.

statements.speaker: Divya Rao
statements.text: I think that’s supposed to be Facilities, but I haven’t seen anyone pick it up.

statements.speaker: Divya Rao
statements.text: I’ll have the July expense variance report ready Wednesday evening.

statements.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
statements.text: Client call with Meridian Logistics got pushed. I need to reconfirm the new time with their team myself.

statements.speaker: Neha Kapoor
statements.text: The campaign deck review — I said Wednesday, but realistically Thursday morning is safer.

emails.subject: Vendor List
messages: Following up from the sync — can you send the updated vendor list today?
Running behind, will send first thing tomorrow morning instead.
No worries, whenever you get a chance today works.
Sorry, got pulled into board prep — will send by tomorrow (Wednesday) morning for sure.
Just checking — still good for this morning?

emails.subject: Q3 Campaign Deck
messages: Deck’s coming together, still targeting Wednesday for your review.
Heads up — shifting the review to Thursday morning instead of Wednesday, need one more day on the data slides.
Understood, Thursday morning works. What time exactly?
Let’s say 9:30 AM Thursday, before your board prep block.
Deck is ready, attaching the draft ahead of our 9:30 review.

emails.subject: Call Reschedule
messages: Our scheduled call this week got bumped from our side — can you propose a new time? We’re flexible Tuesday–Thursday afternoons.
Apologies for the delay — how about Wednesday 3:00 PM?
Wednesday 3 PM works on our end, confirmed.
Quick check — still on for 3 PM today?

emails.subject: Expense Variance Report
messages: Starting on the July variance numbers, targeting Thursday morning for board prep as discussed.
Actually, can I get it by Wednesday evening instead? Want time to review before Thursday.
Wednesday evening is tight but doable, I’ll prioritize it.
Got it, thank you — exactly what I needed before tomorrow.

emails.subject: Mumbai Office Lease Renewal
messages: Reminder: the Mumbai office lease renewal requires an authorized signature by Friday, 25 September.
Following up from the sync — has anyone confirmed who’s signing off on the Mumbai renewal? Don’t think it’s been assigned.
Not on my end — I believe this typically sits with Facilities directly, not us.
Second reminder: signature is still pending. Deadline is Friday, 25 September, end of day.
This is now one day out and still unowned — can you confirm who’s handling it?

voice_notes.title: Personal voice memo — Monday 21 Sep
voice_notes.text: Quick note to self — need to get Raghav that vendor list, I think I said today but it might slip to tomorrow morning, remind me. Also still haven’t heard back on the Mumbai lease thing, someone needs to own that, I don’t think it’s me.

voice_notes.title: Personal voice memo — Wednesday 23 Sep
voice_notes.text: Reminder — expense variance report from Divya needs to be in my hands by Wednesday evening, not Thursday, I want time to go through it before board prep. Also Meridian call — I owe Priya a time, need to lock that in today.
